description: This Java class 'InMemoryTbTransportQueueFactory' implements the 'TbTransportQueueFactory' interface, providing methods to create various in-memory queue producers and consumers for transport API requests, responses, notifications, and other transport-related messages within the Thingsboard project. It manages queue templates and topic configurations for in-memory transport queues.

classes.name: InMemoryTbTransportQueueFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating in-memory transport queues and related templates for Thingsboard's transport API.

methods.name: createTransportApiRequestTemplate
methods.description: Creates a request template for transport API requests and responses using in-memory queues.

methods.name: createRuleEngineMsgProducer
methods.description: Creates a producer for ToRuleEngine messages.

methods.name: createTbCoreMsgProducer
methods.description: Creates a producer for ToCore messages.

methods.name: createTbCoreNotificationsMsgProducer
methods.description: Creates a producer for ToCoreNotification messages.

methods.name: createTransportNotificationsConsumer
methods.description: Creates a consumer for transport notifications.

methods.name: createToUsageStatsServiceMsgProducer
methods.description: Creates a producer for ToUsageStatsService messages.

methods.name: createHousekeeperMsgProducer
methods.description: Creates a producer for ToHousekeeperService messages.
